g.text: Two large investments supported Costa Rica's public university and health systems.
Source: World Bank Projects & Operations List; IBRD Statement of Loans and Guarantees (DS00047, snapshot 09/30/2026). Nominal = original principal at approval.
Real = adjusted using US GDP deflator. Highlighted years are discussed in the narrative.
